agent_report.summary: Scaffolded the static daily planner (index.html, style.css, planner.js pure state module, app.js DOM wiring, package.json with node --test) implementing bounded priorities (max 3), unbounded tasks, keyboard-operable add/toggle/delete with a two-click delete guard, and localStorage persistence. 7 automated tests pass; manually verified in headless Chromium at 360px viewport (limit enforcement, visual distinction beyond color, no horizontal scroll, reload persistence). Opened PR #9 closing Issue #8, and appended the state/storage-schema and delete-guard decisions to DECISIONS.md for future weekly/deadline Issues.
